```sql
SELECT *
FROM Resposts
WHERE Ratings = 5
  AND IsNearBeach = TRUE
ORDER BY Cost;
```

This query will:
- Filter for hotels with 5-star ratings (`Ratings = 5`)
- Filter for hotels near the beach (`IsNearBeach = TRUE`)
- Order results by cost (location) to help the user see options sorted by price
- Return all columns so the user can see all available information about each hotel
